verses.greek: Οὗτος γὰρ ὁ Μελχισέδεκ, βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ἱερεὺς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου, ὁ συναντήσας Ἀβραὰμ ὑποστρέφοντι ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς τῶν βασιλέων καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτόν,
verses.literal: This for the Melchizedek king of Salem priest the of God the Most High who having met with Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and having blessed him
verses.dgt: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

verses.greek: ᾧ καὶ δεκάτην ἀπὸ πάντων ἐμέρισεν Ἀβραάμ, πρῶτον μὲν ἑρμηνευόμενος βασιλεὺς δικαιοσύνης ἔπειτα δὲ καὶ βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ὅ ἐστιν βασιλεὺς εἰρήνης,
verses.literal: to whom also a tenth of all apportioned Abraham first indeed being translated king of righteousness then however also king of Salem which is king of peace
verses.dgt: to whom Abraham also apportioned a tenth of everything, is first, by translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace.

verses.greek: ἀπάτωρ, ἀμήτωρ, ἀγενεαλόγητος, μήτε ἀρχὴν ἡμερῶν μήτε ζωῆς τέλος ἔχων, ἀφωμοιωμένος δὲ τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ θεοῦ, μένει ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸ διηνεκές.
verses.literal: Without father without mother without genealogy neither beginning of days nor of life end having made like however as the Son the of God he remains a priest unto the all time.
verses.dgt: Without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, he remains a priest continually.

verses.greek: Θεωρεῖτε δὲ πηλίκος οὗτος ᾧ δεκάτην Ἀβραὰμ ἔδωκεν ἐκ τῶν ἀκροθινίων ὁ πατριάρχης.
verses.literal: do consider now how great this one was to whom a tenth Abraham gave out of the best spoils the patriarch.
verses.dgt: Now consider how great this man was, to whom Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth from the spoils.

verses.greek: καὶ οἱ μὲν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Λευὶ τὴν ἱερατείαν λαμβάνοντες ἐντολὴν ἔχουσιν ἀποδεκατοῦν τὸν λαὸν κατὰ τὸν νόμον, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν, καίπερ ἐξεληλυθότας ἐκ τῆς ὀσφύος Ἀβραάμ·
verses.literal: And those indeed out from the sons of Levi the priestly office receiving a commandment have to take a tenth from the people according to the law That is from the brothers of them though having come out of the loin of Abraham.
verses.dgt: And those from the sons of Levi who receive the priesthood have a commandment according to the law to collect a tenth from the people, that is, from their brothers and sisters, although they also came from Abraham’s body.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ μὴ γενεαλογούμενος ἐξ αὐτῶν δεδεκάτωκεν Ἀβραάμ, καὶ τὸν ἔχοντα τὰς ἐπαγγελίας εὐλόγηκεν.
verses.literal: The one however not tracing his ancestry from them he has collected a tenth from Abraham and the one who is having the promises He has blessed.
verses.dgt: But the one whose genealogy is not traced from them collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed the one who had the promises.

verses.greek: χωρὶς δὲ πάσης ἀντιλογίας τὸ ἔλαττον ὑπὸ τοῦ κρείττονος εὐλογεῖται.
verses.literal: Apart from now all dispute the inferior by the superior is blessed.
verses.dgt: And without any dispute, the lesser is blessed by the greater.

verses.greek: καὶ ὧδε μὲν δεκάτας ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἄνθρωποι λαμβάνουσιν, ἐκεῖ δὲ μαρτυρούμενος ὅτι ζῇ.
verses.literal: And here indeed tithes dying men receive in that place however it is testified that he lives on.
verses.dgt: And here mortal people receive tithes, but there one receives them of whom it is testified that he lives.

verses.greek: καὶ ὡς ἔπος εἰπεῖν, διʼ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Λευὶ ὁ δεκάτας λαμβάνων δεδεκάτωται,
verses.literal: And so a word to speak through Abraham also Levi the one tithes receiving has paid the tithe.
verses.dgt: And, so to speak, through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, paid tithes,

verses.greek: ἔτι γὰρ ἐν τῇ ὀσφύϊ τοῦ πατρὸς ἦν ὅτε συνήντησεν αὐτῷ Μελχισέδεκ.
verses.literal: Still for in the loin the of his father he was when he met with him Melchizedek.
verses.dgt: for he was still in the body of his ancestor when Melchizedek met him.

verses.greek: Εἰ μὲν οὖν τελείωσις διὰ τῆς Λευιτικῆς ἱερωσύνης ἦν, ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἐπʼ αὐτῆς νενομοθέτηται, τίς ἔτι χρεία κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἕτερον ἀνίστασθαι ἱερέα καὶ οὐ κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Ἀαρὼν λέγεσθαι;
verses.literal: If indeed then perfection through the Levitical priesthood were — the people for upon it has received the Law — what still need was there according to the order of Melchizedek for another to arise priest and not according to the order of Aaron to be named?
verses.dgt: Now if perfection were through the Levitical priesthood—for under it the people received the law—what further need would there have been for another priest to arise according to the order of Melchizedek and not be named according to the order of Aaron?

verses.greek: μετατιθεμένης γὰρ τῆς ἱερωσύνης ἐξ ἀνάγκης καὶ νόμου μετάθεσις γίνεται.
verses.literal: When is being changed for the priesthood from necessity also of law a change takes place.
verses.dgt: For when the priesthood is changed, of necessity there is also a change of law.

verses.greek: ἐφʼ ὃν γὰρ λέγεται ταῦτα φυλῆς ἑτέρας μετέσχηκεν, ἀφʼ ἧς οὐδεὶς προσέσχηκεν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ·
verses.literal: He concerning whom for are spoken these things to a tribe another has belonged to from which no one has served at the altar.
verses.dgt: For the one about whom these things are said belonged to another tribe, from which no one has served at the altar.

verses.greek: πρόδηλον γὰρ ὅτι ἐξ Ἰούδα ἀνατέταλκεν ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν, εἰς ἣν φυλὴν περὶ ἱερέων οὐδὲν Μωϋσῆς ἐλάλησεν.
verses.literal: It is evident for that out of Judah has sprung the Lord of us as to which a tribe concerning priests no thing Moses spoke.
verses.dgt: For it is evident that our Lord arose from Judah, a tribe concerning which Moses said nothing about priests.

verses.greek: Καὶ περισσότερον ἔτι κατάδηλόν ἐστιν, εἰ κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα Μελχισέδεκ ἀνίσταται ἱερεὺς ἕτερος,
verses.literal: And more excessive yet evident it is if according to the likeness of Melchizedek arises a priest another
verses.dgt: And this is even more evident if another priest arises according to the likeness of Melchizedek,

verses.greek: ὃς οὐ κατὰ νόμον ἐντολῆς σαρκίνης γέγονεν ἀλλὰ κατὰ δύναμιν ζωῆς ἀκαταλύτου,
verses.literal: who not according to a law of a commandment fleshly has been constituted but according to the power of a life indestructible
verses.dgt: who has become one not according to a law of a fleshly commandment but according to the power of an indestructible life.

verses.greek: μαρτυρεῖται γὰρ ὅτι Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.
verses.literal: It is testified for that You are a priest to the age according to the order of Melchizedek.
verses.dgt: For it is testified, “You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.”

verses.greek: ἀθέτησις μὲν γὰρ γίνεται προαγούσης ἐντολῆς διὰ τὸ αὐτῆς ἀσθενὲς καὶ ἀνωφελές,
verses.literal: A putting away indeed for there is while is preceding the commandment because of the its weakness and uselessness —
verses.dgt: For on the one hand there is a setting aside of the former commandment because of its weakness and uselessness,

verses.greek: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐτελείωσεν ὁ νόμος, ἐπεισαγωγὴ δὲ κρείττονος ἐλπίδος, διʼ ἧς ἐγγίζομεν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: no thing for perfected the law — the introduction then of a better hope through which we draw near the to God.
verses.dgt: for the law perfected nothing; but on the other hand there is the introduction of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

verses.greek: Καὶ καθʼ ὅσον οὐ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας (οἱ μὲν γὰρ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας εἰσὶν ἱερεῖς γεγονότες,
verses.literal: And to as much as not apart from an oath. 21 those ones truly for without an oath are priests having become
verses.dgt: And to the extent that it was not without an oath—for they became priests without an oath,

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ μετὰ ὁρκωμοσίας διὰ τοῦ λέγοντος πρὸς αὐτόν· Ὤμοσεν κύριος, καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται, Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα),
verses.literal: He however with an oath through the One who is saying to Him: Has sworn the Lord and not will change His mind You are a priest to the age
verses.dgt: but he with an oath through the one who said to him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind: You are a priest forever”—

verses.greek: κατὰ τοσοῦτο κρείττονος διαθήκης γέγονεν ἔγγυος Ἰησοῦς.
verses.literal: By so much of a better covenant has become the guarantee Jesus.
verses.dgt: to that extent Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.

verses.greek: Καὶ οἱ μὲν πλείονές εἰσιν γεγονότες ἱερεῖς διὰ τὸ θανάτῳ κωλύεσθαι παραμένειν·
verses.literal: And those indeed many are having become priests because of the by death being prevented from continuing
verses.dgt: And the former priests were many in number because death prevented them from continuing,

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ διὰ τὸ μένειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀπαράβατον ἔχει τὴν ἱερωσύνην·
verses.literal: the However because of the abiding of Him to the age a permanent He holds the priesthood
verses.dgt: but because he remains forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

verses.greek: ὅθεν καὶ σῴζειν εἰς τὸ παντελὲς δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους διʼ αὐτοῦ τῷ θεῷ, πάντοτε ζῶν εἰς τὸ ἐντυγχάνειν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: wherefore also to save to the uttermost He is able those drawing near through Him the to God always living for the to intercede for them.
verses.dgt: Therefore he is also able to save completely those who approach God through him, since he always lives to intercede for them.

verses.greek: Τοιοῦτος γὰρ ἡμῖν καὶ ἔπρεπεν ἀρχιερεύς, ὅσιος, ἄκακος, ἀμίαντος, κεχωρισμένος ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν, καὶ ὑψηλότερος τῶν οὐρανῶν γενόμενος·
verses.literal: Such indeed for us also was fitting a high priest holy innocent undefiled separated from the sinners and higher than the heavens having become
verses.dgt: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and having become higher than the heavens.

verses.greek: ὃς οὐκ ἔχει καθʼ ἡμέραν ἀνάγκην, ὥσπερ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς, πρότερον ὑπὲρ τῶν ἰδίων ἁμαρτιῶν θυσίας ἀναφέρειν, ἔπειτα τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ (τοῦτο γὰρ ἐποίησεν ἐφάπαξ ἑαυτὸν ἀνενέγκας)·
verses.literal: who not has every day need as the high priests first for the their own sins sacrifices to offer up then for those of the people this for He did once for all Himself having offered up.
verses.dgt: He has no daily need, like the high priests, first to offer sacrifices for his own sins and then for those of the people, for he did this once for all when he offered himself.

verses.greek: ὁ νόμος γὰρ ἀνθρώπους καθίστησιν ἀρχιερεῖς ἔχοντας ἀσθένειαν, ὁ λόγος δὲ τῆς ὁρκωμοσίας τῆς μετὰ τὸν νόμον υἱόν, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τετελειωμένον.
verses.literal: The law for men appoints as high priests having weakness the word however of the oath which is after the law a Son to the age perfected.
verses.dgt: For the law appoints people as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son who has been perfected forever.
